items.stem: A campaign spends $200 and produces $800 in attributed sales. What is its ACOS?

options.rationale: That is ROAS expressed as a percentage, not ACOS.
This misplaces the decimal; 200/800 is 25%, not 4%.

items.stem: Which TWO actions use a search-term report to improve Sponsored Products results? (Select TWO.)

options.text: Add irrelevant, non-converting terms as negative keywords
options.rationale: Correct: negatives stop wasted spend on irrelevant searches.

options.text: Promote high-converting search terms into targeted keywords
options.rationale: Correct: targeting proven terms focuses budget where it converts.

options.text: Delete all reports to simplify the account
options.rationale: Reports are the basis for optimization.

options.text: Raise every bid equally regardless of term performance
options.rationale: Uniform bid increases ignore the report's signal.

items.explanation: Correct: both keyed options are right; the distractors are wrong for the reasons given.
